column4: isometric dungeon diorama: cool blue-grey stone, warm amber torch and hero light, blue-black fog over unopened rooms; every figure drawn with its own outline (figures.png); fog retreats radially from the opened door (index.html:369)
fog lifts only when a door opens (index.html:352), d20 dice (index.html:457), and each enemy's target marked on the board with a dashed line and crosshair
2D-drawn isometric board; camera pans with arrows/WASD or right-drag, zooms with the wheel or Q/E, and recentres on the active hero at each turn (index.html:379)
setup screen picks 1-4 players and each player's class; each hero starts in its own corner (index.html:172)
25x25 grid of nine 7x7 rooms with 12 doors; unopened rooms in fog (index.html:369)
3 AP per turn (config ap_per_turn); move 1, attack 1, open door or chest 1, cards 1-2 (config *_cost)
tooltip shows the real chance and the d20 roll needed, with cover and distance penalties itemised; each consecutive hero miss adds miss_pity to the next chance
4 classes with 2 cards each; cooldown set on use and counted down at the hero's turn start (index.html:383); shown on the card (evidence/play.png)

skeleton melee, goblin archer keeps range, fast rat; patrol, then chase on sight, then attack; eye icon shows patrol or chase (index.html:1110), target line shows intent (index.html:1182); boss never moves and slams a marked 3x3 (index.html:707)
a hero at 0 HP is downed; chests give a Tónico (index.html:448); used on an adjacent downed ally it raises them at tonic_revive_hp %, or the holder drinks it
top-left shows round, player and class, AP and HP; top-right shows the goal and the boss bar once awake
every hero and enemy attack rolls a d20 from the seeded rng, shown as a die with the number needed
pillars and chests on the line or beside the target on the shooter's side each cost cover_penalty %; enemy archers seek tiles with less cover too
rooms open only through doors; enemies in unopened rooms stay hidden and dormant
card cooldowns tick each own turn; a card in cooldown shows "Recarga: N"
patrol between two waypoints, chase what they see (or the last place seen), attack in range
chests hold Tónicos that raise a downed ally
player count and classes chosen before the game
setup screen: number of players and a class each
the hero's corner room is lit and the rest of the board is fog
the active hero's reachable tiles are lit blue at once; no click on the hero is needed (a small change from the line)
opening a door costs 1 AP, the fog retreats from the door, and the room's enemies wake on patrol
hovering an enemy shows "Ataque: N% (X+ en d20) · D daño" with the cover penalty listed; the exact 62% of the line is not a possible value here, since chances move in 5% steps
attacking shows a tumbling d20, then its number, colour for hit or miss, and the needed roll
on the enemy turn a skeleton that sees a hero shows "¡Alerta!", its eye turns red and a dashed line marks who it goes for
after a card is used, its face shows "Recarga: N turnos" while the other stays ready
when the first serious fight arrives depends on the players' route; the rooms and enemy counts are built (index.html:176), and the timing needs a real play
downed heroes are raised only by a Tónico from a chest, used by an adjacent ally
when every hero is down the game-over screen offers R, Enter or a click to retry the level
the boss waits in the central room with skeleton escorts, never moves, marks a 3x3 slam and hits adjacent heroes
